summary:
I measured every building's roof outline from above and checked the main ones against the ground. There is no hidden downscale: one common scale fitted over all campus buildings is 1.003 ± 0.006, rotation -0.45 ± 0.35°, so there is no single global skew either. The real skew is per building and it is a model error. Long edges from three image sources put every real campus block on one grid of about -2.8 to -3.4°. The model's orientations are spread from -1.2 to -2.8°: Hall/HallWing are 1.5° off, the Pavilion 2.2°, A and C 0.5°.
- **Main cause: Bing was wrongly assumed to be straight-down.** It is not. Bing and Esri both lean strongly west: on the 28-30 m towers their whole east facades are visible, about -0.4 and -0.5 m of shift per metre of height. Google 2026 shows no facades on those same towers, so it is near straight-down (lean about -0.05 E / +0.03 N). It also matches the football pitch to 0.2 m, so it can be trusted for absolute positions.
- **The earlier note had the lean backwards.** "Google leans 0.29 E / 0.20 N relative to Bing" is really Bing leaning about -0.29 / -0.20.
- **Block C is the right size but in the wrong place.** Its length is within 0.2 m, but it sits 4.3 E / 1.1 N (± 0.7 m) away from the rest of the campus, and its 0.55° turn is within measuring error. Its entrance canopy, at only 3.4 m high, is also offset 4 m east, so this is a real offset, not lean. "Register on C" would therefore shift everything else by about -3.9 / -1.0 m. I report absolute positions (checked against the pitch) as the main frame.
- **Other buildings placed from Bing are shifted too:**
  - D_W is +8.1 E / +5.3 N and only about 56 m long, not 61.
  - The Hall group is +2.0 N, and the Hall plus its east block is 2.8 m shorter than modelled.
  - The A_N north end really sits 3.6 m further north: the 09-27 move south followed Bing's lean.
  - The Pavilion and Canteen are +1.1 to 1.4 E.
- **Gaps between buildings are mostly 1-3.5 m off** for the same reasons.
- **B is undersized**: its roof edge is 50.66 × 26.42 m against the model's 49.28 × 25.46.
- Context buildings (OSM outlines) mostly line up within about 1 m. 13 are flagged, and one (206623867) wrongly includes a car park.

global_checks.check: Common scale model->measured (similarity fit over all campus eave-edge stations, Google z20, D excluded)
global_checks.result: scale 1.0026 +-0.0060, residual rms 1.51 m (residuals are per-building errors, not a common factor). With D_W/D_M: 0.9911 +-0.0036, pulled down by the 5 m too-long D_W. Per-building eave size ratios run from -4.3 % (Hall + HallEast length) to +5 % (Pavilion); B +2.8 %/+3.8 %, Canteen +2.2 %, C -0.7 % (length). No downscale.

Global similarity rot -0.45 +-0.35 deg (absolute), +0.34 deg relative to C. Per building (Google, CW negative): A_S -0.46, A_N -0.57, A_W -0.46, B -0.16, C -0.55, Canteen -0.59, D_W -0.38, D_M +0.18, Hall -1.53, HallWing -1.57, Pavilion -2.17. Same sign in Esri (median -0.73) and Bing (median -0.95). Ground control: pitch -0.02/-0.03 deg, so the imagery is not rotated. Measured real orientations cluster at -2.8..-3.4 deg; the model's x_dir values are spread over -1.2..-2.8 deg.

global_checks.check: Lean vectors (m of roof shift per m of height)
global_checks.result: Google z20 (2026): x -0.051 +-0.023 (Huber fit on 23 OSM context outlines); y +0.03 +-0.03 (tower facade bands <=0.8 m at 28-30 m). Bing z19: about (-0.41, -0.23) at C (roof edges vs Google) and about -0.4 in x at tower 635535022 (11 m of east facade visible). Esri z19: about (-0.47 +-0.06, -0.1 +-0.15) at C and about -0.6 in x at the tower. Bing and Esri are not straight-down.

Google z20 vs model pitch slab (h = 0): t = (+0.22, -0.03) m, rot -0.03 deg. Model courts (SITE_Sports slabs 2-5) are 1.4-2.3 m south of Google and rotated -0.3 to -0.6 deg (outside this task's scope).

global_checks.check: Gaps between neighbours, eave-to-eave, model vs measured (m)
global_checks.result: B-A_S 12.46 vs 11.16; A_N-C 15.52 vs 14.31; A_W-C 16.11 vs 14.12; C-HallWing 19.22 vs 21.85; C-Hall 23.49 vs 24.25; Hall-Pavilion 34.35 vs 31.77; C-Canteen 8.90 vs 7.77; HallWing-Canteen 28.08 vs 27.40; A_N-Canteen 46.68 vs 43.55; Hall-A_N 29.99 vs 26.43; B-C 57.41 vs 59.31; B-Hall 54.24 vs 54.72. Error about +-0.3. B-A_S walls: 12.1 measured vs the 13.43 m the model uses as a scale reference.

Directional Lab-gradient profiles every 0.5 m across each model edge; translation-consistent peak vote, then manual pick wherever the overlay showed a shadow or internal line; RANSAC + least-squares line per edge (inlier threshold 0.15 m). Per-edge error = fit se (+-0.01-0.03) combined with a 0.10 m edge-definition floor; curve-only edges +-0.15-0.18. Positions also carry the pitch offset (+-0.15) and Google lean (+-0.03 x h). Esri/Bing sizes agree with Google only to +-1-1.5 m (blur, trees, visible facades), so they serve as checks on rotation and lean, not as precise sizes.
